ammonia.reason: Very young low proteolysis with no surface flora, minimal NH3 from amino acid deamination.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk with no Propionibacterium or fecal phenols; clean dairy farm note only.

bitter.reason: Low accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from rennet/chymosin in 8-15 day age.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no Roquefort-blue methyl ketone 2-heptanone/2-nonanone dominance.

browning.reason: Young high-moisture rennet cheese with residual lactose/lysine undergoes mild Maillard when heated.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism yields high diacetyl-acetoin in young pasteurized curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate-low lipolysis total FFA ~5.8 g/kg gives mild butanoic/hexanoic sweaty note via native lipase.

creaminess.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter ~57% and moisture 44% with uncooked pressed paste gives smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Supple elastic rennet gel pH 5.0-5.7, low calcium loss, fractures little unlike aged alpine.

firmness.reason: Soft semi-hard body from high moisture fat-free basis 66-72%, short press, no cooking.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine Strecker phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol due to short ripening.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate/ethyl hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids by lactococcal esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goat-specific branched 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No cooked curd Strecker 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal nor propionibacterial nutty notes.

melt.reason: Intact rennet casein at pH ~5.3-5.7 with high moisture flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No mold-derived 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from Penicillium linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: High fat 31.9% with young weak fat-protein network releases moderate free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mesophilic starter lactic and trace acetic acid retained in high-moisture young acid curd.

stretch.reason: Not pasta-filata hot-stretched; rennet gel gives only short extensibility, no fibrous stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMDS and light pasteurization cooked note only.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and milkfat lactones plus low salt 1.74% perceived as milky sweet.

umami.reason: Short proteolysis yields low free glutamate from Lactococcus cell-envelope proteinases.
